prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: deployable portfolio website concept screenshot
Primary request: Create a polished desktop website mockup for a game developer portfolio with a meaningful chatbot. This is concept 3 of 5 and should center on an interactive game shelf exploration flow.
Scene/backdrop: full-browser screenshot where the portfolio feels like a curated game library or shelf, but still clearly a professional website
Subject: an interactive game shelf layout with large horizontal game covers or cartridges, expandable details, a profile strip for the developer, skills and tools area, and a chatbot that acts like a discovery guide recommending games based on role, engine, genre, or lesson learned
Style/medium: high-fidelity website UI, tactile and memorable, practical enough to build
Composition/framing: wide desktop page, visually strong shelf metaphor in the center, content drawers or panels below, assistant integrated into browsing flow instead of standard support chat
Lighting/mood: playful but professional, inviting
Color palette: dark pine, soft cream, copper accents, muted cyan supporting color
Materials/textures: wood or matte shelf hints, clean panels, subtle depth, no heavy skeuomorphism
Text (verbatim): "Hong Jinho", "Game Library", "Projects", "Skills", "Tech", "Ask the Guide"
Constraints: clearly communicate games, developer profile, technology, and chatbot; emphasize discovery and comparison between projects; no watermark
Avoid: arcade cabinet fantasy, retro pixel overload, generic ecommerce look, duplication of concepts 1 and 2
summary: Concept 03 treats the project list like a curated game library, making exploration more tactile while the chatbot helps compare titles and connect each game to the developer's strengths.
generation_notes: Generated with the built-in image_gen tool in default mode. Selected as the most metaphor-driven browsing concept in Set B, with a stronger collection/discovery feel than the other layouts.
